en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hisham Bin Salim, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>
regarding the man who marries a virgin. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘He should stay with her for seven days’.
en.sarwar: 39. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘ Umayr from Hisham ibn Salim who has said the following: “About the case of a man who marries a virgin woman, abu ‘ Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘He must stay with her for seven days.’”
